ogw.text: In Oath of the Gatewatch, Gideon, Jace, Chandra and Nissa swear an oath on the cliffs of Tazeem to stand together and found the Gatewatch against the Eldrazi titans Ulamog and Kozilek and the planeswalker Ob Nixilis.
Jace devises a plan with Nissa to shape the leylines into a binding glyph while Gideon lures the titans into the ambush.
The Gatewatch binds Ulamog and Kozilek in a web of leylines and burns them, ending Kozilek's material manifestation on Zendikar.

aer.text: In Aether Revolt, the Gatewatch and Ajani support the renegades on Kaladesh while searching for Tezzeret, and Baral taunts Chandra to lure her away from the rest of the Gatewatch.
The Gatewatch plans with the renegades to take over the Aether Hub to fuel an airship and hinder Tezzeret, and Liliana and Saheeli rescue Rashmi from him.
The revolt turns to reform, Baral is arrested, and Ajani joins the Gatewatch, who deduce that Bolas is behind Tezzeret.

hou.text: In Hour of Devastation, the Gatewatch strikes down the demon Razaketh, sparing Liliana from using the Chain Veil, and it fights the Eternals alongside Hazoret, Samut and the faithful on Amonkhet.
Bolas tells the Gatewatch that everything on Amonkhet exists or perishes at his whim, and he easily defeats them, so that Gideon, Chandra, Nissa and Liliana flee, with Chandra badly wounded.
